formulaBlock.normalization: No split entries; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong (C1, reinforcing route): Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) is the defining ether-sulfate anionic and further prominent strong anionics of the same type are listed before Parfum: Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate (14), Magnesium Laureth Sulfate (16), Magnesium Laureth-8 Sulfate (17), Sodium Oleth Sulfate (19), Magnesium Oleth Sulfate (20). Under C1 a reinforcing route gives strong.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: The reinforcing ether sulfates sit after Glycol Distearate (15) and look like a small mild magnesium-ether-sulfate blend; three buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine 3, Coco-Glucoside 5, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate 6) and Glyceryl Oleate (7) argue for moderate. Counter-signals lower confidence only (C rules).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: no cationic polymer, silicone or payload lipid; only weak refatters Glyceryl Oleate (7), Hydrogenated Vegetable Glycerides Citrate (22), pearlizing Glycol Distearate (15) and humectants Panthenol (10), Glycerin (13).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Refatter plus pearlizer plus humectants are several light routes (neighbor moderate).

weightPotential.rationale: Low: the only deposition family is weak refatters (Glyceryl Oleate 7, Hydrogenated Vegetable Glycerides Citrate 22), facing a reinforced ether-sulfate chassis.

resetCapacity.rationale: SLES plus reinforcing ether sulfates, with buffers.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Single weak-refatter family with strong reset: low anchor.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Only one deposition family (weak_refatter), no polymer, silicone or lipid; W2 not triggered; moderate would need at least one plausible depositing system.

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Piroctone Olamine (8), Sodium Salicylate (9), Menthol (12), Caffeine (11): scalp-active architecture; needs a dandruff claim. Caffeine is not a focus route (F5). Lengths care-direction: nonspecific.

usageRole.rationale: Default; with strong cleansing, alternating needs reset intent (U4); treatment needs a dandruff claim (U3).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No positioning yet. CSA formula half met: prominent Panthenol (10) comfort route, Glyceryl Oleate (7), Glycerin (13) humectant/refatting routes. Counter-signals: cleansingStrength strong, prominent Menthol (12).
